source_count_convention: assumed output-grid Poisson sensitivity; EXPTIME sums and PHOTFNU do not calibrate local effective electrons; native drizzle source covariance omitted

uncalibrated_drizzle_counterexample.scope: Analytic counterexample only: output-grid Poisson cannot replace native transport

interval_scope: conditional 1000 site bootstrap; two count realizations averaged within site; uncalibrated coverage, no field/cosmic/PSF/gain uncertainty; extremes do not bound unseen failures
interpretation: unmasked fixed-field conditional selection response and assumed-profile color scattering; no real-source truth labels, survey completeness, contamination fraction or population likelihood
